Alberto has built three AI agents:

1. **Fraud Detection Agent** (offline-evals) – For an online event ticketing platform, it reviews newly published events and organizers, recommending approve/reject/request-info with reasons for a human admin. It auto-approves only on evidence verified in code, and web sources can hold decisions back but never approve autonomously. Offline evals showed significant improvements: fraud approval fell from 54% to 8% over twelve iterations on a local 9B model, and fraud approved without human review dropped from 27% to 0%. Claude Haiku 5.5 is chosen for deployment with 86% accuracy vs 71%, and only 1% of fraud approved vs 8%.

2. **Organizer Support Agent** (coming-soon) – For an online event ticketing platform, it answers event organizers' questions about sales, payouts and setup without human review, pulling live data from PostgreSQL and the payments API.

3. **Portfolio Agent** (personal-project) – An agent on his portfolio site that answers visitors' questions about his experience and projects in natural language. Also exposed as an MCP server so external agents can query it.

Full CV and booking: https://alberto-cv.example.net/book
